fr-route-napoleon.slogan: Route Napoleon – 224 km between Grenoble and Cannes
fr-route-napoleon.story: Sustained elevation change, linked bends and open summit views. It also links naturally to Upper Provence cultural landscape.
fr-route-napoleon.legalNote: Check mountain-pass openings, low-emission zones and local restrictions. Specific flag: seasonal traffic.

scenicChapters.title: Route Napoleon
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 59 km this is Route Napoleon, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
